infobox.usage: Unlocks the cash registers of the Goshan store on Interchange.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Goshan cash register key (Goshan reg.) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Goshan store outlet cash registers at the ULTRA shopping mall.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - 1 needs to be obtained for the quest Supervisor

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text: - On the seat of a white bus that is part of the roadblock next to the new gas station

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Cash registers in the front of the Goshan store on Interchange.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text: - The content of 30x Cash register TAR2-2

sections.heading: Trading
sections.text: | Toilet paper x6; Toilet paper; +; Repellent x5; Repellent; +; SurvL Survivor Lighter x2; SurvL Survivor Lighter; +; Pack of chlorine x2; Pack of chlorine | → | Jaeger; Jaeger LL3 | → | Goshan cash register key; Goshan cash register key |

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: The key also unlocks 3 erroneously locked TAR2-2 cash registers on Streets of Tarkov. 2 in the "Shestyorochka" store and 1 in the "Kostin" store.
